Package restaurantrush.boundary

Enum Class DemoJump

java.lang.Object
java.lang.Enum<DemoJump>
restaurantrush.boundary.DemoJump
All Implemented Interfaces:
Serializable, Comparable<DemoJump>, Constable
public enum DemoJump extends Enum<DemoJump>
Saved points in the game that we can jump to during the demo in the pixel-art window.

A jump creates a new Game with the default seed and replays the moves from our recorded runs (runs/stage3-victory.txt or runs/stage3-defeat.txt) up to the chosen turn. Since the game uses a fixed seed, the same jump always gives the same state. Jumping back just starts a new game again.

The replay only calls the normal public Game methods, so the rules are the same as in a normal game.
